summaries.Romania: Romania faces significant political uncertainty as coalition negotiations continue following government instability, while healthcare innovation struggles with the delayed eSănătateaMea platform launch and PNRR fund losses mount due to legislative gridlock.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on drug pricing negotiations, GLP-1 weight management expansion, and surgical technology adoption, while the sector grapples with cybersecurity threats and workforce sustainability challenges.
summaries.Tech: Apple enters a new era with John Ternus taking over as CEO from Tim Cook, while the tech industry accelerates with major AI deployments, infrastructure investments, and competitive smartphone launches.

items.title: STAT+: FDA clears Stryker’s ‘surgical cockpit’ that uses Apple’s VR headset, Vision Pro
items.snippet: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: Stryker deploys Apple's VR headset Vision Pro for a surgical use case, chatbots for loneliness, and more.
items.line: Stryker deployed Apple Vision Pro in surgical settings, marking the first major enterprise healthcare adoption of Apple's spatial computing platform.

items.title: Apple leadership page updated as John Ternus becomes the new CEO
items.snippet:

items.line: John Ternus officially becomes Apple CEO as Tim Cook transitions to executive chairman after 15 years, marking a historic leadership change for the tech giant.

items.snippet: Deși a fost declarată funcțională începând de astăzi, platforma eSănătateaMea nu e, de fapt, chiar funcțională. Teoretic, reprezintă o veritabilă revoluție în sistemul medical și presupune, printre altele, că fiecare dintre noi își poate accesa, dintr-un click, dosarul cu tot istoricul medical, își
items.line: Romania's eSănătateaMea platform, meant to revolutionize medical record access, launched non-functional on day one, highlighting systemic healthcare digitization challenges.

items.title: Rusia a distrus punctul vamal de la Orlivka, la granița României cu Ucraina. Traficul în vama Isaccea a fost suspendat
items.snippet: Rusia a lovit din nou la granița cu România și a distrus un punct de trecere, Orlivka, vama din Ucraina, care face legătura cu țara noastră. Efectele acestei lovituri se văd și în țara noastră, nu se mai poate trece prin acest punct de frontieră. La Isaccea mașinile sunt redirecționate.
items.line: Russian attacks destroyed the Orlivka border crossing with Ukraine, directly impacting Romanian border operations and demonstrating regional security volatility.

items.title: Social-democrații au votat: Guvern propriu sau în jurul PSD, variantele puse pe masa lui Nicușor Dan. Ce s-a mai decis la Sinaia
items.snippet: Liderii PSD de la București, președinții de filială din țară, dar și parlamentarii social-democrați s-au reunit la Sinaia pentru a stabili ce se întâmplă cu guvernarea. Social-democrații îi vor propune președintelui Nicușor Dan fie un Guvern minoritar PSD, inclusiv cu premier din rândurile partidulu
items.line: PSD leadership met in Sinaia to chart coalition strategy, signaling potential government formation around their party despite current political fragmentation.

items.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
items.snippet: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nation’ agenda.
items.line: White House announced nine new MFN drug pricing deals with mid-sized pharmaceutical companies, expanding Trump's price negotiation agenda beyond initial industry leaders.

items.title: McKesson confirms cybersecurity incident as hackers claim millions of patient records stolen
items.snippet: Healthcare giant McKesson Corporation confirmed on Friday that it was investigating a cybersecurity incident tied to third-party applications that led to unauthorized access and theft of data.
items.line: McKesson, a major US healthcare distributor, suffered a significant cybersecurity breach with millions of patient records reportedly stolen, exposing critical healthcare supply chain vulnerabilities.

items.title: iOS 27 beta 8 now available as Apple tests major Siri AI upgrade
items.snippet:
Apple has released the eighth iOS 27 beta for developer testing. iOS 27 beta 8 continues Apple’s summer beta cycle ahead of a public release in September. We’ll update our devices and share what we discover.



Update 5:04 p.m. ET: Now available for public beta testers as well. 



 more…
items.line: iOS 27 beta 8 introduces major Siri AI upgrades, signaling Apple's commitment to on-device intelligence ahead of the September iPhone event.

items.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
items.snippet: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
items.line: Apple submitted 'shocking evidence' against a former engineer accused of stealing trade secrets for OpenAI, alleging evidence destruction after investigation awareness.

items.title: Hackers claim millions of patient records stolen during data breach at healthcare giant McKesson
items.snippet: The company, which distributes medicines and medical devices to hospitals and healthcare practices across the U.S., said it was hacked and expects intermittent service degradation.
items.line: Hackers claim to have stolen millions of patient records from healthcare giant McKesson during a data breach involving third-party application vulnerabilities.
